caption: The drawing depicts a standing female figure, positioned on a rectangular black base. She wears a green dress with a yellow bodice and a red decorative pattern along the skirt's edge, with an outer light blue garment draped over her shoulders, featuring a red border trim. Her legs are covered in red leggings decorated with gold lines, and she wears brown shoes. On her head, she has a headdress composed of white feathers with red tips and a green band, and her dark brown hair is partially visible. She raises her right arm, holding an object resembling a cluster of red leaves or corn, and her left hand rests atop her midsection, holding the blue garment. She also has a gold armband on her raised right arm. The background of the drawing is plain, with off-white coloring and some handwritten text in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Pocahontas
